question: At present, the ratio of the ages of Meena and Sita is 5 : 4 and sixteen years from now, the ratio will get changed to 9 : 8. Find the present age of Meena.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio = 5 : 4 ⇒ let ages = 5x, 4x

After 16 years ⇒ (5x + 16) : (4x + 16) = 9 : 8

Cross multiply ⇒ 8(5x + 16) = 9(4x + 16)

⇒ 40x + 128 = 36x + 144

⇒ 4x = 16 ⇒ x = 4

Meena’s age = 5x = 20

**∴ Answer = 20 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present ratio (Meena : Sita) = 5 : 4

After 16 years ratio = 9 : 8

**Formula used:**

Age relation with time addition

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present ages = 5x and 4x

⇒ After 16 years: (5x + 16) / (4x + 16) = 9 / 8

⇒ 8(5x + 16) = 9(4x + 16)

⇒ 40x + 128 = 36x + 144

⇒ 4x = 16

⇒ x = 4

⇒ Meena’s age = 5x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method

Assume variables based on ratio

Future Age

Add same number of years to both

Cross Multiplication

Solve ratios using cross multiplication

Key Insight

Convert ratio into linear equation
